name: smart-health-kiosk
description: Monorepo root — run npm install here, then npm run dev (starts API + both UIs).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix ./backend && npm install --prefix ./hospital-dashboard && npm install --prefix ./super-admin-dashboard
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,hospital,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start:backend" "npm run dev:hospital" "npm run dev:admin"
